cues.text: Think of a variable as a labeled box in the computer's memory.
cues.speaker: narrator

cues.text: The name on the box is how your program finds it later.
cues.speaker: narrator

cues.text: Inside the box is the value. That is the information the name currently holds.
cues.speaker: narrator

cues.text: When we write score equals ten, we are not creating a second box.
cues.speaker: narrator

cues.text: We are replacing whatever was inside. The name stays. The value can change.
cues.speaker: narrator
